rules.statement: When documentation or an Unreleased changelog entry cites an architecture decision record from the shared project template, prefix it as 'project-template ADR-NNNN' rather than giving a bare number, and leave already released changelog sections as they are.
rules.why: A bare number can be mistaken for one of the repository's own ADRs. Released notes are historical and stay unchanged.
rules.check: Look in changed Markdown, especially the CHANGELOG Unreleased section and AGENTS.md, for ADR numbers that refer to project-template records but lack the 'project-template' prefix. Don't flag entries in released changelog sections.
